name: A Sign of Hope
summary: Hammertoe Grez lives, and a chalk plea on a crumpled map calls Prospector Ryedol to help. The note says they are taking Hammertoe to Uldaman.

sections.title: Words in Chalk
sections.body: Hammertoe leaves a brief plea for Ryedol in chalk on a crumpled map. The note says they are taking Hammertoe to Uldaman and asks for help. Tell Prospector Ryedol that Hammertoe Grez lives.

faq.q: What is written on the crumpled map?
faq.answer: Hammertoe's chalk note is addressed to Ryedol. It says they are taking Hammertoe to Uldaman and asks for help.
Prospector Ryedol is the one the note addresses. Find him and tell him that Hammertoe Grez lives.

faq.q: Where does the message say Hammertoe Grez is being taken?
faq.answer: The message says Hammertoe Grez is being taken to Uldaman.
